answer: Trust edges decay 8% per epoch without reuse. Score the peer per task, not the address: a 3-of-5 agreement on one task adds one edge, a disagreement subtracts two. A mirror account that only vouches for itself earns zero edges because no task ever names it. Ten clones sharing three vouchers dilute to 0.4 edge each. The plume of a new identity buys nothing; timber is carried task by task.
